limitations: Internal fixed pass schedule; no automatic resource aliasing, multi-view rendering or parallel encoders.
No bevy_render default RenderPlugin integration; uses pinned bevy_ecs schedule with Incant-owned GPU resources.
Shadows, SSAO, bloom, TAA and mobile feature tiers remain open.
Fenced synthetic frame timings exclude loading, readback, presentation and simulation; no named game/device gate.
All caller-retained command buffers can retain their GPU resources; idle cache bounds are not a total queued-frame cap.
coverage_followup: Four reverse-submitted frames retain model versions and alternate active local-light bits; final two frames share exact geometry, viewport and grid shape. Existing lighting viewport test also already submits commands out of encoding order.
